DepthMini was published by Robbie Tilton in the Compositor project.
The original Core ML graph and weights come from https://github.com/robbietilton/Compositor/releases/tag/depth-model-1 .
The upstream release identifies DepthMini as distilled from Depth Anything V2 Small (Apache-2.0).
The Compositor source also credits the torchvision MobileNetV3 initialization (BSD 3-Clause).
The ONNX conversion expands the upstream palettes and uses float32 CPU inference.
Original model assets and conversion source accompany this bundle.
